title: XCF Global, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing executive changes: termination of CFO William Dale (April 9, 2026), resignation of CAO Pamela Abowd (effective April 30, 2026), and appointment of Harvey Schnitzer as new CFO (effective April 13, 2026) under a services agreement with ZRG Interim Solutions at $12,500/week.
